title: Buying a trumpet and teaching himself
summary: He bought a trumpet because he liked how it looked, learned by himself, and likes Bunk Johnson and Bix, combining the two (his alias 'Bunk Beiderbecke').

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: Well, how'd you get started on trumpet?

Well, quite a few years ago, I just happened to be downtown, and I saw this fine looking trumpet in the show window. And, of course, I didn't know anything about music, couldn't play, but I just fell in love with the looks of the horn, see. So, I went and invested a few dollars, and I just had to learn to play it, see. I mean, I couldn't see letting that money just lay around doing nothing, so I did learn to play the horn.
No, no, I play strictly by, yeah. Everything I play is by, yeah.
Well, did anybody help you at all on putting the horn in the right position on your lips? No. Fingering?
Well, I tell you, after playing it about seventeen years, I still don't know if I've got the right position.
Seventeen years ago, it started about, huh? Who did you hear that influenced you on trumpet at first?

Well, I can't think of any one in particular, but I always did like the way Bung Johnson played, and of course I also liked the Baidebeck style. So what I try to do is combine the two together, and sometimes I'll come up with something maybe worthwhile listening to. Bung Baidebeck.
Bung Baidebeck. That's what they call you. That's my alias. Let's see now.
